metadata.description: One-minute BTC up/down. The strike is the BTC spot print when the window opens; at close the spot print decides up (at or above the strike) or down. The book quotes the up side; down is its complement.
metadata._capabilities_note: post_only, gtd (expire_after) and reduce_only are the engine additions the venue adapter ships with the automation runtime (agent_docs/automation-implementation.md §3.8.6); flip a flag off here and the compiler refuses the order flag.
metadata._runtime_note: The exchange's book is a non-uniform tick grid (0.1c at the extremes, 1c in the middle). Limit prices are snapped to the nearest venue tick at placement; the registry tick is the finest grid a price expression may name.

signals.description: Coinbase BTC-USD spot ticks. Event-driven: publishes on each tick; last is the traded price in USD.
The strike of the active btc_usd up/down window: the spot print captured at window open, in USD. Publishes once per window, at open.

Market state for the active btc_usd up/down window. Event-driven: publishes on book change. Per-outcome implied probabilities (up, down — mid-based complements). bid/ask/last quote the up side of the book. Resets at window rollover.

Window lifecycle for the active btc_usd up/down window. Level, not edge: phase is the current lifecycle state, published on each phase change and on every clock tick while open; seq increments once per window and never repeats; remaining is the time to close in milliseconds (0 once locked).

The trade tape of the active btc_usd up/down window. Event-driven: publishes once per fill. taker is the aggressing account's address; side is the taker's side on the up book; price is the fill price on the up side; size is the filled quantity in tokens.
Platform-computed (spot - strike) / strike for the active btc_usd up/down window. Recomputed on each spot tick; resets at window rollover. Fraction, not percent: 0.0008 = 0.08%.

Platform-computed fair probabilities for the active btc_usd up/down window from spot, strike and time remaining (the exchange's own fair-value model). Recomputed on each spot tick and clock tick. Per-outcome fields (up, down). Resets at window rollover.
